Class ComparativeBatchExecutionCoordinator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.analytics.ComparativeBatchExecutionCoordinator
public final class ComparativeBatchExecutionCoordinator extends Object
Headless Simulation Batch Execution and Queue Coordinator.

Coordinates multithreaded deterministic headless batch runs, cancellation tokens, interactive simulation collision avoidance, ETA calculations, and confirmation dialogs.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
